subject: Pilot readiness: recap, owners, and access checklist - Novamed AI
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novamed.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
Cc: Salim Rahman <salim.proc@novamed.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call

Thanks for running through the demo this morning. A couple quick clarifications from our side so we can move to a pilot: 

- Primary pain: clinical note ingestion yields inconsistent entity extraction for medications and procedures; downstream triage workflows miss ~20% of items.
- Top goal for pilot: improve extraction recall for meds/procedures to >90% on the seeded test dataset and cut manual triage time by 30%.
- Data: we'll provide a redacted S3 bucket (~150k notes) and a 1k labeled seed for eval; procurement will handle paperwork next week.

Appreciate if you can confirm what success looks like on your side and what access you need to start.

Carlos
Director of Product
Novamed AI
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novamed.ai>
Cc: Salim Rahman <salim.proc@novamed.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff recap and next steps (scope, metrics, owners, access)

Hi Carlos — great to connect today, and thanks for the clear summary. Recapping the pilot plan and next steps below so everyone has a single source of truth. I put owners next to each item for clarity.

Scope and primary objectives:
- Scope: clinical note processing (meds + procedures) only for initial pilot (1 workload).
- Success metrics:
  - Entity extraction recall (meds/procedures) target: >= 90% on seeded eval set.
  - Latency target: 95th percentile generation latency < 500ms for individual inference calls (average prompt size).
  - Operational: end-to-end human triage reduction >= 30% within the pilot window.

Prompt/eval plan:
- We'll use the seed file you provide (1k labeled examples) + an augmented prompt set (we will generate ~200 prompt variants for stress tests).
- Monica will own the evaluation harness and report format (F1/precision/recall + confusion breakdown).

Owners and responsibilities:
- Stephanie Nguyen (sales & program lead): overall pilot coordination, weekly check-ins, success criteria sign-off.
- Monica Patel (customer success): evaluation harness, prompt set construction, quality regression alerts.
- Aditya Rao (infrastructure): provisioning dedicated sandbox, IAM roles, VPN/S3 connectivity, obs/logging hooks.
- Novamed: Carlos (data/product) will own data delivery and labeling clarifications; Salim (procurement) will own PO/contract paperwork.

Timeline (tentative):
- Day 0 (this week): finalize MSA/PO and DocuSign (Salim + Legal).
- Day 3: Novamed provides redacted S3 path and sample 100 notes for quick smoke test.
- Day 7: Redwood lands sandbox, IAM roles, and a running inference endpoint; smoke test report from Monica.
- Day 14: Full seed eval run (1k labeled) + prompt stress tests; initial metrics report.
- Day 21: Review session with Novamed to iterate on prompts/thresholds and agree on go/no-go.

Access & setup checklist (Aditya / Novamed action items):
- Provide S3 bucket ARN with read permissions to a service principal (we will request minimal-access role).
- For PHI concerns: provide redaction checklist and confirm sample redaction prior to transfer.
- Network: establish VPN tunnel details OR provide temporary pre-signed URLs; Aditya will share the IAM role name and the onboarding doc.

Attachments included in this thread:
- novamed-pilot-charter-v1.pdf (charter + success criteria)
- prompt-eval-seed.csv (template for seed labels)

Related links:
- Google Drive folder with templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovamedPilot
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/8342

Immediate asks for Novamed (action by EOD Wed):
1) Salim: confirm PO timeline and counterparty (so we can book dedicated capacity).
2) Carlos: upload a 100-note sample and share redaction notes.

Aditya / Monica — can you confirm the sandbox provisioning ETA? I'll schedule the Day 7 smoke test once we have the sample.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novamed.ai>, Salim Rahman <salim.proc@novamed.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff recap and next steps (provisioning notes)

Quick update on infra tasks and what I'll need from Novamed: 
- I'll spin up a dedicated sandbox (small GPU pool) by EOD Tue once PO is confirmed.
- I need: S3 bucket ARN + AWS account ID (or pre-signed test URLs) and an allowlist of source IPs for the VPN (if they want tunnel).
- Logging: we'll enable token-level latency metrics and per-request tracing to the shared Drive folder (read-only).
- Compliance note: we'll enable customer-managed KMS if Novamed requests; flag that early so legal can confirm.

I'll track these in the shared Drive under onboarding/infra.md.

—Aditya
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novamed.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
Cc: Salim Rahman <salim.proc@novamed.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff recap and next steps (ack)

Thanks — this looks good and very clear. Salim will ping procurement to get the PO started today. We'll upload the 100-note sample to the Drive link and share the S3 ARN by EOD Tue.

Carlos
